extraMeanings.tr: gelip çatmak, aniden gelmek (kötü bir durum)
extraMeanings.en: (of something bad) to happen to someone suddenly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A feeling of dread overtook her as she opened the letter.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Mektubu açarken içini bir korku kapladı.

extraMeanings.en: to turn over or capsize
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The boat overturned in the rough sea.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Tekne dalgalı denizde alabora oldu.

extraMeanings.en: a flat surface with controls or instruments on it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The pilot checked the instruments on the control panel.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Pilot kontrol panelindeki göstergeleri kontrol etti.

extraMeanings.en: to walk softly and quietly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cat padded across the room without a sound.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kedi ses çıkarmadan odanın öbür ucuna yürüdü.

extraMeanings.en: very careful and demanding about details or standards
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She is very particular about how her coffee is made.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kahvesinin nasıl yapıldığı konusunda çok titizdir.

extraMeanings.en: to mend or repair, or fix software with a patch
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He patched the hole in his jeans.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kot pantolonundaki deliği yamadı.

extraMeanings.en: a period of time, especially a difficult one
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They went through a rough patch in their marriage.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Evliliklerinde zor bir dönem geçirdiler.

extraMeanings.en: obvious or clear
extraMeanings.exampleEn: His explanation was a patent lie.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Açıklaması apaçık bir yalandı.

extraMeanings.en: a customer of a shop, restaurant, or hotel
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The restaurant's regular patrons all know the owner by name.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Restoranın düzenli müşterileri sahibini adıyla tanır.

extraMeanings.tr: yol açmak, zemin hazırlamak (pave the way)
extraMeanings.en: to make something possible or easier to happen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: This discovery paved the way for further research.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bu keşif, daha ileri araştırmalara zemin hazırladı.

extraMeanings.en: to touch or scrape with a paw, or to touch someone in an unwanted way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The dog pawed at the door, wanting to go out.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Köpek dışarı çıkmak isteyerek kapıyı pençeledi.

extraMeanings.tr: en yüksek seviyeye ulaşmak, zirve yapmak
extraMeanings.en: to reach the highest point or level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Sales peaked in December and then declined.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Satışlar aralıkta zirve yaptı, sonra düştü.

extraMeanings.en: at the highest or busiest level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Traffic is heaviest during peak hours.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Trafik en yoğun saatlerde çok ağırdır.

extraMeanings.en: to remove the skin, or to come off in strips
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She peeled an orange for the children.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Çocuklar için bir portakal soydu.

extraMeanings.en: to look quickly or secretly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She peeped through the curtains to see who was outside.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dışarıda kimin olduğunu görmek için perdenin arasından baktı.

extraMeanings.en: to look carefully or with difficulty
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He peered at the tiny print through his glasses.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Gözlüğüyle küçük yazıya dikkatle baktı.

extraMeanings.en: to fix or limit something at a particular level
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The currency is pegged to the US dollar.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Para birimi ABD dolarına sabitlenmiştir.

extraMeanings.en: to succeed in entering a market or organization
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The company struggled to penetrate the Asian market.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şirket Asya pazarına girmekte zorlandı.

extraMeanings.en: to regard or think of someone or something in a particular way
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He is often perceived as arrogant by his colleagues.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Meslektaşları onu genellikle kibirli olarak görür.

extraMeanings.en: to become more cheerful or lively
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She perked up as soon as she heard the good news.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi haberi duyar duymaz neşelendi.

extraMeanings.en: to continue to exist or happen
extraMeanings.exampleEn: If the symptoms persist, you should see a doctor.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Belirtiler sürerse bir doktora görünmelisiniz.

extraMeanings.tr: küçük şeylere takılan, dar görüşlü, kıl
extraMeanings.en: caring too much about small, unimportant things
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Don't be so petty about who paid for lunch.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Öğle yemeğini kimin ödediği konusunda bu kadar küçük olma.

extraMeanings.en: to introduce or remove gradually in stages
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government plans to phase out the old currency.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet eski para birimini aşamalı olarak kaldırmayı planlıyor.

extraMeanings.en: (of sound or light) to cut sharply through
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A scream pierced the silence of the night.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bir çığlık gecenin sessizliğini yardı.

extraMeanings.en: a person or thing that is an important supporting part of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was a pillar of the local community.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: O, yerel toplumun bir dayanağıydı.

extraMeanings.tr: iğnelemek, tutturmak; bir yere sıkıştırıp kımıldatmamak
extraMeanings.en: to fasten with a pin, or to hold someone firmly so they cannot move
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She pinned the notice to the board.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Duyuruyu panoya iğneledi.

extraMeanings.tr: özlem çekmek, hasretle içi gitmek (pine for)
extraMeanings.en: to feel a strong longing for someone or something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He pined for his homeland after moving abroad.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yurt dışına taşındıktan sonra memleketinin hasretini çekti.

extraMeanings.en: to be the first to develop or use something new
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team pioneered a new surgical technique.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ekip yeni bir cerrahi tekniğe öncülük etti.

extraMeanings.en: to illegally copy and sell a product
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The film was pirated and shared online before its release.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Film vizyona girmeden önce korsan olarak çoğaltılıp internette paylaşıldı.

extraMeanings.tr: başına bela olmak, rahat vermemek, sürekli sıkıntı vermek
extraMeanings.en: to cause continual trouble or distress to someone
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Money problems plagued him for years.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Para sorunları yıllarca başına bela oldu.

extraMeanings.tr: hep birlikte (para) toplamak, ortaklaşa katkı koymak
extraMeanings.en: to contribute money together with others
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Everyone pitched in to buy her a gift.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ona hediye almak için herkes para koydu.

extraMeanings.en: to blame someone for something, often unfairly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They tried to pin the blame on the new employee.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Suçu yeni çalışanın üstüne yıkmaya çalıştılar.
